name: Cyrenaica winter: 1–20 January 1942 (linked research)

aim.cw: Keep Tobruk and the Egyptian line secure, consolidate the ground won or retained in Cyrenaica, and protect supply before another advance.
aim.axis: Preserve a mobile force and a western supply base, probe the Commonwealth's exposed flank, and prepare a counterattack if the played balance of supply and strength permits.

about: A played continuation into January 1942; no historical retreat, port capture or fixed new tank strength is imposed. The historical Axis line reached Marada–Mersa Brega by 10 January, but a counterfactual player may hold very different ground. Command aims are adapted to this map-scale chapter, not verbatim orders. Repair capacity, serviceable tanks, new shipping and exact January unit strengths still require research and rules.

add_units.name: 1st Armoured Division HQ
add_units.arrives_note: Official despatch places this division in Cyrenaica by 21 January. 1 January field entry is a game estimate; if Tobruk is lost it enters from the Commonwealth base.

add_units.name: 2nd Armoured Brigade (1st Armoured Division)
add_units.arrives_note: Official despatch identifies the brigade in the January retreat. 70 serviceable tanks and 1 January are game estimates.

add_units.name: Guards Brigade (1st Armoured Division)
add_units.arrives_note: Official despatch identifies the brigade in the January retreat. 3,000 men and 1 January are game estimates.
